headline: Saudi Arabia Construction Costs Increase 2.3% Year-on-Year in October
summary: Saudi Arabia's Construction Cost Index rose 2.3% in October 2026 compared to last year. Non-residential construction costs led the increase, rising 2.7% according to GASTAT.
why: Saudi Arabia is executing multi-billion dollar Vision 2030 giga-projects, making building materials and labor inflation critical for budget execution.
